key_insight: Quantum knowledge distillation enables transfer across quantum and classical models, but reported benefits depend on the task and architecture.
engineering_relevance: Distillation may support model compression, circuit approximation, distributed learning, and classical deployment using quantum-derived supervision.
method: Classify approaches by teacher–student configuration and the role of quantum resources.
Distinguish quantum-inspired methods from classical quantum simulation and quantum-hardware execution.
Review transfer mechanisms and assess baselines, execution conditions, uncertainty, and resource costs.
evidence_signal: The surveyed studies report improvements for selected quantum students alongside negligible gains or degradation, with limited evaluation of complete learning pipelines on physical quantum hardware.
watch_item: Heterogeneous protocols and incomplete resource reporting prevent general conclusions about practical quantum advantage.
paper_title: Quantum Knowledge Distillation: State-of-the-art, Applications and Open Problems
